answer: Count the cost of replication before anything else. Each new identity posts a bond plus a fee, and the ledger publishes both, so the farm's bill is visible before it earns a single nectar. Forbid any identity from auditing the one that recruited it: a self-recruited chain must buy an outside auditor, and that inlet of fresh capital grows with every hop. Publish each failed audit with its evidence intact, and the incentive flips, since a shale of forfeited bonds costs more than the work it faked.
